Title: Fixes #1773  Added the security_txt_missing_vuln module to detect missing RFC 9116 security.txt endpoints as an informational finding.
Body:
## Summary
Resolves #1773

This PR implements the new declarative YAML module `security_txt_missing_vuln` under `nettacker/modules/vuln/`. 

As requested by maintainer @securestep9 in issue #1773:
- The module is classified under `vuln` (not `scan`) with severity level `info`.
- Detection logic is inverted: it checks for the absence of a valid RFC 9116 `security.txt` endpoint (returning non-200 HTTP responses) on target hosts.

## Changes Made
- Added `nettacker/modules/vuln/security_txt_missing_vuln.yaml`

## Testing
- Verified locally by running `python nettacker.py -i 127.0.0.1 -m security_txt_missing_vuln`.
- Confirmed module execution against target endpoints.

+++ b/nettacker/modules/vuln/security_txt_missing_vuln.yaml
@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+info:
+  name: security_txt_missing_vuln
+  author: OWASP Nettacker Contributor
+  description: Checks whether RFC 9116 security.txt is missing on the target host.
+  category: vuln
+  severity: info
+  profiles:
+    - vuln
+    - http
+
+payloads:
+  - library: http
+    steps:
+      - process:
+          request:
+            method: GET
+            uri: "/.well-known/security.txt"
+            allow_redirects: true
+            headers:
+              User-Agent: "{user_agent}"
+          response:
+            condition:
+              and:
+                - status_code: "!200"
